subject: Temporary capacity uplift for launch week — pricing & settlement proposal
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara@velox.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@velox.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Launch week capacity surge — request for temporary uplift

Hi Jonas,

We have a hard launch scheduled for Nov 18 and based on our load tests we expect a 6–8x token throughput spike for a 48-hour window. Can Redwood provide a temporary quota uplift and a short-term rate limit increase to avoid throttling?

Primary asks:
- Temporary quota increase to support up to 8x normal throughput for 48 hours (Nov 18 00:00 UTC — Nov 19 23:59 UTC)
- Clear overrun settlement terms and a capped surcharge if we exceed the uplift
- Confirmation on how billing / PO should flow for an emergency uplift

We are happy to sign a short amendment and provide a PO. What pricing can you offer for the uplift + any true-up discounts for annual customers?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Kim
Head of Platform
VeloxAI

Attachments: load_test_summary.csv (attachment stub)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sara Kim <sara@velox.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity surge — request for temporary uplift

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the upcoming launch. We can support a short-window uplift; I looped in Ben (billing) and Laura (contracts) to align on the commercial path.

Quick summary of what we'll propose:
- Provision a 48-hour temporary capacity lane covering up to 8x baseline throughput
- Apply a 35% surcharge on units consumed above the customer’s committed baseline during the uplift window (this is capped at a flat fee not to exceed $15k for the 48-hr window)
- If actual overrun is <40% of uplifted capacity, we will offer a 10% off settlement (true-up credit) as a goodwill gesture for annual customers
- Require an approved PO before we enable the uplift; we can provision on receipt and provision an invoice after the window for reconciliation

Ben / Laura — can you confirm the surcharge cap and whether we can auto-apply the goodwill true-up credit on settlement? Also attaching a short proposal doc for Sara to review.

Next: I can push the uplift to our infra team as soon as PO is in and finance clears. Sara — I'll send a formal PDF with exact numbers in the next message.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415-555-0123

Jonas / Laura / Sara — quick notes from billing on the mechanics:

- Surcharge structure: 35% uplift-rate on per-token charges above baseline for the uplift window. We can cap the surcharge liability at $15,000 for the full 48-hour window as requested.
- True-up credit: we can automatically apply a 10% credit to the overrun delta if VeloxAI is within the 40% threshold. This will appear as a credit line in the following month’s invoice (not a retroactive rebate).
- PO + billing flow: Procurement should submit a PO referencing amendment ID VELX-2391-UPLIFT. We’ll accept the PO via email; legal will finish a two-clause amendment for signatures (simple). Once PO is received we’ll provision the uplift to the dedicated pool and snapshot usage for audit.
- Evidence for audit: we’ll provide token-level export for the uplift window and a short reconciliation report.

Note: Laura, please confirm amendment language for the cap and the automatic credit.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

- Window: Nov 18 00:00 UTC — Nov 19 23:59 UTC (48 hours)
- Capacity: up to 8x baseline throughput
- Overrun surcharge: 35% on units above baseline during the window, capped at $15,000
- Goodwill true-up: 10% credit automatically applied to the overrun delta if actual usage above baseline is <=40% of uplifted capacity
- PO: Please email procurement@redwood.ai with PO referencing amendment VELX-2391-UPLIFT. We’ll countersign the two-clause amendment and invoice after the event for reconciliation.

I attached the amendment PDF and a one-page reconciliation checklist. Once we have the PO we’ll put the uplift in staging and notify your ops lead.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth launch.

Best,
